serialize.note: Best of five lua_States. Lua randomises string hashing per state, so collision patterns and therefore cost differ every boot: measured across ten runs the spread of a single state is 6.9%. Taking the best of several brings it to 0.55%, which is what makes a 2% tolerance mean anything. The earlier note here claimed 0.6% from three samples and was simply wrong.
